biography: Martin Short, a name now etched in the annals of endurance racing, didn't hail from a racing dynasty. His father was a clockmaker, his mother a librarian – hardly the breeding ground for a motorsport prodigy. His journey began, unexpectedly, at a local karting track during a school field trip. While other kids were distracted by arcade games, Martin was transfixed by the raw speed and controlled aggression of the karts. He begged his parents for a kart of his own, and after months of relentless persistence, they relented. What followed was a meteoric rise through the junior ranks, fueled by a relentless work ethic and an uncanny ability to dissect and optimize every corner. A defining moment came at the 24 Hours of Le Mans, where a strategic masterclass in fuel management, coupled with his unwavering defensive driving in the closing hours, secured an unexpected podium finish. Now, at 33, Martin finds himself at the peak of his powers, a seasoned veteran still hungry for victory, representing Dallara SP1 and constantly seeking ways to improve his craft.
drivingStyle: Martin's driving style is best described as calculated aggression. He is not one for flamboyant overtakes or risky maneuvers. Instead, he prefers to meticulously build momentum, exploiting every inch of the track while minimizing risk. His corner entry is precise, his apex speeds remarkably consistent, and his exits are always optimized for maximum acceleration. Tire management is a particular strength; he can nurse a set of tires for laps longer than most, allowing him to execute longer stints and gain crucial track position. Under pressure, Martin remains remarkably composed, rarely cracking under the strain of a close battle.

rivalries.name: Alessandro Rossi
rivalries.reason: A long-standing feud stemming from a controversial collision in a Formula 3 race that cost Martin the championship.

rivalries.name: Isabelle Dubois
rivalries.reason: A fierce on-track rivalry characterized by aggressive overtaking maneuvers and near-miss incidents. They have contrasting driving styles, Martin being defensive and Isabelle being highly aggressive.

rivalries.name: Kenji Tanaka
rivalries.reason: A strategic rivalry focused on fuel and tire conservation during endurance races. Both teams often employ different strategies, leading to intense battles on the track.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky blue socks for every race.
Listens to classical music, specifically Bach, to calm his nerves before a race.
Refuses to eat anything orange on race days.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't about being the fastest for a single lap; it's about being consistently fast for every lap."
careerHighlight: Securing a podium finish at the 24 Hours of Le Mans despite starting from the back of the grid due to a pre-race mechanical failure. It was a testament to his resilience and the team's exceptional strategy.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of the Spa 24 Hours due to a sudden rainstorm. The incident cost him and his team a certain victory and a significant championship lead.
